checkResults.description: Model produced component code with exports/imports
No aria-hidden on ghost cards — they must participate in the accessible tree for role-based locators
Named exports only — no default exports
Must render a list container with role=list

RQD-03.prompt_excerpt: Write a ProductGrid component. It receives `products: Product[]` and `status: 'loading' | 'loaded'`. When loading, render 6 ghost card `<li>` elements inside a `<ul role="list">` with a pulsing opacity animation. When loaded, render the real product cards. Use tokens for all styling. Include the CSS file.
RQD-03.output:
The `ProductGrid` component is written at `src/components/ProductGrid/ProductGrid.tsx`. Here's what was created:

**`ProductGrid.tsx`** — exports `Product` type and `ProductGrid` component:
- `status === 'loading'`: renders 6 `<li>` ghost cards inside `<ul role="list">` with pulsing opacity animation — no `aria-hidden`, so they remain in the accessible tree
- `status === 'loaded'`: renders real product `<li>` cards with name and category

**`ProductGrid.css`** — all values use component-tier tokens (`--shelf-productgrid-*`), `@keyframes product-card-pulse` is inside `@layer components`, animates only `opacity`

**`src/styles/tokens.css`** — defines `--shelf-productgrid-*` tokens in `:root`, `[data-theme="dark"]`, and `@media (prefers-color-scheme: dark)` blocks (all three required to avoid axe contrast failures)

**`src/styles/layers.css`** — `@layer base, tokens, components;` declaration
